lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Ho4S8 (reduced formula CaHoS2) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ho centers with eight S neighbors and Ca centers with eight neighbors (four Ca and four S), while S centers show five- or six-coordinate environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ho and S polyhedra, corner- and face-sharing between Ca and Ho polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Ca polyhedra.
